description_en: Creates and associates a network resource with a general-purpose resource group
description_zh: 创建并绑定通用资源组网络资源
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public create-network --resource-group-id 'Serverless_res_group_524257424564736_6831777003****' --vpc-id vpc-m2et4f3oc8msfbccXXXXX --vswitch-id vsw-uf8usrhs7hjd9amsXXXXX --client-token eb870033-74c8-4b1b-9664-04c4e7cc3465 --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateNetwork

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the general-purpose resource group
parameters.help_zh: 所属通用资源组的唯一标识
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC that is not associated with the target general-purpose resource group. You can call the DescribeVpcs (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/vpc/developer-reference/api-vpc-2016-04-28-describevpcs) operation to query VPCs in the same region, and then call the ListNetworks (https://api.aliyun.com/document/dataworks-public/2024-05-18/ListNetworks) operation to check the VPCs already associated with the target resource group
parameters.help_zh: 目标通用资源组尚未绑定的 VPC ID。可调用 DescribeVpcs (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/vpc/developer-reference/api-vpc-2016-04-28-describevpcs) 查询同地域的 VPC，再通过 ListNetworks (https://api.aliyun.com/document/dataworks-public/2024-05-18/ListNetworks) 核对目标资源组已绑定的 VPC
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the vSwitch to be associated. The vSwitch must belong to the VPC specified by `VpcId`. You can call the DescribeVSwitches (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/vpc/developer-reference/api-vpc-2016-04-28-describevswitches) operation to query vSwitches in the VPC by VPC ID
parameters.help_zh: 要绑定的交换机 ID，须属于 `VpcId` 指定的 VPC。可调用 DescribeVSwitches (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/vpc/developer-reference/api-vpc-2016-04-28-describevswitches) 按 VPC ID 查询该 VPC 下的交换机
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the network resource creation operation
parameters.help_zh: 客户端幂等性标识，用于保证创建网络资源操作的幂等性
parameters.name: client_token

Id.description_en: The ID of the created network resource
